messages.text: Since you're browsing our desktop globes, a desk globe is a great fit if you want something that shares space on a desk, shelf, or credenza — it adds presence without taking over a room. A floor globe is more of a standalone statement piece, usually for a study or living room where it has its own footprint. What's the room you're picturing it in — a desk setup or more of an open floor space?
